note: Fall 2026 (Bi-Semester), Department of Law & Justice (LL.B, LL.M). Printed slips recorded as meant: "Pre-Registration for Spring 2026" (29 Oct - 4 Nov 2026) is Spring 2027's, and "22 Non-23 Nov" is 22-23 Nov. The calendar puts the supplementary final examination (24-29 Dec) inside its semester break (23-31 Dec), as printed. Club, wellbeing, census, parents', sports, field-visit and research-showcase days and staff deadlines are left out. classes-pause is the last class before the mid-term, not the end of teaching.
